column4: Papa, main ek AI bot se baat kar raha hoon... jo humein crorepati bana sakta hai!
Kaise?
Mujhe 1 minute mein 100 crore ka business bana ke do. Profit 100% ho. Aur koi galti nahi honi chahiye.
Ye technology toh humari hai! Transformer model humne banaya tha! Uska kya hua?
Toh phir mera beta Google AI ki jagah ChatGPT kyun use kar raha hai?
Kyunki... hum ise launch karne se dar rahe the.
Toh ab kuch bhi launch karo! Bard bolo, Gemini bolo, jo mann kare bolo. Bas launch karo!
Gemini, ye batao duniya ka sabse popular insaan kaun hai?
Modi Ji.
Modi Ji kaun?
Modi sarkaar.
Humara app kutton ko walk pe le jaata hai... par best route chunne ke liye hum machine learning use karte hain.
Chup! Ye lo 5 crore dollar.
Aap humara demo nahi dekhenge?
Hum ek aisa app bana rahe hain jisse aap Voldemort se direct baat kar sakte ho... wo bhi Python mein.
Next, please.
Isme hum AI use kar rahe hain.
AI? Sach mein?
Yes.
Ye lo 100 million dollar.
Sam, humare hisaab se 2025 mein revenue 20 billion dollar hoga. Aur tum keh rahe ho 2029 tak 100 billion kar doge?
Humein isi speed se grow karna hoga.
Sam, ise speed nahi kehte. Ye toh aise insaan ka banaya hockey stick graph hai, jisne kabhi hockey kheli hi nahi. Pata hai, sirf try karne mein kitna paisa lagega?
2029 tak 115 billion dollar ka cash burn.
Aur profit kab aayega?
2029 mein. Shayad 2030 mein. Ya 2031?
Aur agar revenue 100 billion tak nahi pahuncha? Agar tumhari hockey stick toot gayi toh?
Toh aur paisa raise kar lenge.
Kisse? Bacha kaun hai? Microsoft? Saudi Arabia? Koi pension fund jo kuch zyada hi optimistic hai?
Arre, duniya mein investors ki kami thodi hai!
Humne chori nahi ki. Humne public data se AI train kiya hai.
Tumne bina permission poore internet ka data utha liya... aur usse paisa kamaya.
Achha... aise bologe toh illegal hi lagega.
